extracted.name: Halloumi Cheese Fingers
extracted.description: A clever recipe for halloumi. Fry or grill this delicious Cypriot-style cheese and serve it with a Greek salad and crusty bread for a complete meal.
ingredient_lines: 6 ounces halloumi cheese, cut into 1/2 inch thick sticks
instruction_lines: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add halloumi sticks and cook until the cheese turns light golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes.
Sprinkle with lemon juice, oregano, and pepper to serve.
